leave.title: My leave
leave.description: Your balance for each kind of leave, and your leave requests. Apply for leave, change it or cancel it here. Your manager decides in Approvals.
leave.denied: You may not use leave screens.
leave.loadError: The leave information could not be loaded.
leave.readOnly: The system is read-only now, so nothing can be sent or changed.
leave.error.generic: The request could not be completed.
leave.error.network: The server could not be reached. Try again.
leave.company.help: You have employment in more than one company. Choose whose leave to show.
leave.noEmployment.body: Leave is kept for a current employment. Ask HR if you think this is wrong.
leave.noPolicy: No leave policy applies. Ask HR.
leave.balances.empty.body: When HR sets up leave types and a leave policy for you, your balances appear here.
leave.why.title: {name}: entries behind the balance
leave.why.body: The balance of leave year {year} is the total of these entries.
leave.entries.caption: Ledger entries of the balance
leave.requests.empty.body: Apply for leave and your requests appear here with their status.
leave.cancel.title: Cancel this leave?
leave.cancel.draftBody: The draft is cancelled. Nothing was taken from your balance.
leave.cancel.approvedBody: The leave is cancelled and the days go back to your balance. Where the leave policy says so, your manager must approve the cancellation first.
leave.cancel.asked: The cancellation was sent for approval.
leave.apply.title: Apply for leave
leave.apply.description: Choose the leave type and the days. The balance after your leave and the reasons for any refusal are shown before you send.
leave.apply.denied.body: Ask HR if you need to apply for leave.
leave.apply.employee.help: Leave it on yourself, or choose an employee to apply for them. What you may do for others is decided by your access.
leave.apply.actingFor.body: The request records that you applied on behalf of the employee. The employee's manager decides it.
leave.apply.type.loadError: The leave types could not be loaded.
leave.apply.to.help: Leave empty for a single day.
leave.apply.hours.help: Hours of leave on this day, for example 2 or 1.5.
leave.apply.document.required: Supporting document (required for this leave type)
leave.apply.document.help: Images (PNG, JPEG) or PDF files. The server refuses a file that is too large or of another kind and says so; files are scanned before they are kept.
leave.apply.documentMissing: This leave type needs a supporting document. Attach one before you send the request.
leave.apply.uploadFailed: The request was saved as a draft, but a file could not be uploaded. Try the failed files again; the request is sent when all files have arrived.
leave.change.title: Change approved leave
leave.change.description: This asks for a new leave in place of the approved one. The approved leave stays as it is until the new one is approved.
leave.preview.title: What will be counted
leave.preview.waiting: Choose a leave type and the first day to see the days counted and your balance after the leave.
leave.preview.refused: This leave cannot be sent as it is
leave.preview.error: The days could not be worked out. Try again.
leave.preview.notSent: Nothing is sent or taken from your balance until the leave can be sent and you press the button.
leave.detail.lowest: (The balance would fall to {lowest}; the policy allows {allowed}.)
leave.days.caption: Days of the leave one by one
leave.day.kind.sandwich: Holiday or weekly off between two leave days, counted as leave
leave.day.kind.off: Holiday or weekly off, not counted
leave.request.title: Leave request {no}
leave.request.description: The details of this request. Decisions are made in Approvals.
leave.request.gone.body: It no longer exists, or you may not see it.
leave.request.days.empty: No days are recorded for this request yet.
leave.request.entries: Ledger entries made by this request
leave.request.files.needed: This leave type needs a document before the request can be sent.
leave.request.history: See who decided and when, in Approvals
leave.facts.onBehalf.you: You, on behalf of the employee
leave.facts.onBehalf.other: Someone else, on behalf of the employee
leave.facts.changes.link: The approved leave this request changes
leave.card.title: Leave request details
leave.card.unavailable: The leave details are not available to you here. Open the document to see what you may.
leave.coverage.unavailable: The team coverage could not be worked out.
leave.coverage.unknown.body: This employee has no line manager recorded, so no team is measured and there is no coverage warning.
leave.coverage.warn.title: Team coverage warning
leave.coverage.warn.body: This is a warning only. You can still decide the request.
leave.coverage.line: {away} of {size} of the team are away on {date}; limit {limit} percent.
leave.coverage.ok: No day goes above the team limit of {limit} percent.
